name: experiment_power
description: Power and sample size for two-sample, one-sample and paired t tests (noncentral t, or the normal approximation) and for comparing two proportions (pooled normal approximation as R's power.prop.test, or Cohen's arcsine h): solve for the sample size per group, the achieved power or the smallest detectable effect, from Cohen's d or means and SD, alpha, one or two sides and an allocation ratio.

solve.description: Default: power when n is given, else n

method.description: t designs: t (default) or normal; two_proportions: normal (default) or arcsine

catalog.source: Cohen (1988), Statistical Power Analysis for the Behavioral Sciences; noncentral t CDF by Lenth (1989), Applied Statistics algorithm AS 243; matches R's power.t.test and power.prop.test and G*Power 3
